summary:
TerraWise — Read the Land from Orbit.

TerraWise is an agricultural intelligence platform that transforms NASA Earth observation and environmental data into meaningful insights for smarter, more sustainable farming decisions.

By integrating data from NASA POWER and MODIS, TerraWise helps users explore environmental conditions, understand agricultural challenges and assess the land through satellite-informed insights. The platform combines data analysis, climate-related information and multi-objective optimization using NSGA-II to support informed agricultural planning.

Our goal is to bridge the gap between complex satellite data and practical agricultural decision-making, making space-based information more accessible and useful for the people who depend on the land.

With TerraWise, we bring the perspective of space closer to the ground — helping turn observations from orbit into possibilities for agriculture.
details:
TerraWise — Read the Land from Orbit.

1. Project Overview

TerraWise is an agricultural intelligence platform designed to bridge the gap between satellite-based Earth observation data and practical agricultural decision-making.

Agriculture is deeply influenced by environmental conditions such as temperature, precipitation, solar radiation and changing land conditions. However, accessing, interpreting and applying this information can be difficult for farmers and agricultural decision-makers.

TerraWise aims to make this information more accessible by transforming NASA Earth observation and environmental datasets into meaningful visualizations, analytical insights and optimization-based decision support.

Our central idea is simple: bring the perspective of space closer to the ground.

2. What Does TerraWise Do?

TerraWise provides an integrated platform for exploring environmental conditions and supporting agricultural planning.

Its core capabilities include:

  • Environmental Data Exploration: Accessing NASA POWER data to examine environmental and climate-related variables relevant to agriculture.
  • Satellite-Based Observation: Incorporating MODIS data to provide additional Earth observation context.
  • Agricultural Intelligence: Presenting environmental information through an accessible interface, helping users understand conditions that may influence agricultural decisions.
  • Multi-Objective Optimization: Implementing the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) to explore competing objectives and identify alternative optimization solutions.
  • Data Visualization: Transforming complex datasets and analytical outputs into visual information that users can interpret more easily.

Rather than treating agricultural decisions as isolated problems, TerraWise aims to bring multiple environmental considerations into one analytical environment.

3. How Does It Work?

TerraWise follows a data-driven workflow:

Step 1 — Data Acquisition

The platform connects with NASA environmental and Earth observation resources, particularly NASA POWER and MODIS, to obtain relevant information.

Step 2 — Data Processing

Retrieved information is processed and organized for analysis and presentation.

Step 3 — Environmental Analysis

The platform presents relevant environmental variables and observations through its interface, helping users explore conditions associated with agricultural planning.

Step 4 — Multi-Objective Optimization

TerraWise incorporates NSGA-II, a multi-objective evolutionary optimization algorithm. Instead of searching for only one solution, NSGA-II explores trade-offs between competing objectives and produces a set of alternative solutions.

Step 5 — Decision Support

The resulting information and optimization outputs are presented through the platform to support more informed agricultural planning.

4. NASA Data and Scientific Foundation

NASA Earth observation resources form an important part of TerraWise.

NASA POWER

NASA POWER provides environmental and meteorological data derived from satellite observations and other scientific data sources. Its variables can help users investigate conditions such as temperature, precipitation and solar radiation that are relevant to agriculture.

MODIS

The Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), carried aboard NASA's Terra and Aqua satellites, provides Earth observation data that can contribute to understanding land and environmental conditions.

These resources provide different perspectives on the environment and help establish the scientific foundation of TerraWise.

5. Technology and Development

TerraWise was developed using a separate frontend and backend architecture.

Frontend

  • React.js
  • JavaScript
  • HTML and CSS
  • React Router
  • Framer Motion
  • Lucide React

Backend and Data Processing

  • Python
  • NASA data API integration
  • Data processing and analytical components
  • NSGA-II multi-objective optimization

Development Tools

  • Visual Studio Code
  • Git and GitHub
  • API integration and testing tools

The architecture separates the user interface from backend processing, allowing the platform to present information while handling data retrieval and computational tasks independently.

6. Benefits and Intended Impact

TerraWise is designed to make space-based environmental information more accessible and useful for agriculture.

Its intended benefits include:

  • Improving access to NASA environmental and Earth observation information.
  • Helping users explore environmental factors that influence agricultural conditions.
  • Supporting data-informed agricultural planning.
  • Making complex scientific information easier to understand through visualizations.
  • Exploring competing agricultural objectives through multi-objective optimization.
  • Encouraging more informed and environmentally conscious agricultural decisions.

In the long term, TerraWise aims to contribute to more informed resource management, agricultural resilience and sustainable farming practices.

It is intended as a decision-support platform, not a replacement for farmers' expertise, field observations or professional agricultural advice.

7. Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of TerraWise lies in bringing multiple capabilities together into one agricultural intelligence platform.

NASA Earth observation data is scientifically valuable, but its practical interpretation can be challenging for people without technical or scientific backgrounds.

TerraWise addresses this accessibility gap by combining environmental data exploration, satellite-based observations, interactive visualizations and multi-objective optimization within one interface.

The integration of NSGA-II adds another dimension: agricultural planning frequently involves competing objectives, and presenting alternative solutions can be more useful than suggesting that one universal solution exists.

Our approach focuses on translating information from orbit into insights that are easier to explore and apply on the ground.

8. Factors Considered During Development

During development, our team considered several important factors:

  • Data Reliability: Prioritizing NASA scientific data sources and dependable data retrieval.
  • Accessibility: Designing an interface that makes complex information easier to understand.
  • Practical Relevance: Focusing on environmental variables with agricultural significance.
  • Computational Feasibility: Using an optimization approach capable of exploring multiple competing objectives.
  • Modularity: Keeping frontend functionality and backend processing separate.
  • Scalability: Structuring the platform so additional data sources and analytical capabilities can be incorporated in the future.
  • Transparency: Distinguishing between observed environmental information, analytical outputs and optimization-based suggestions.

9. Our Vision

TerraWise represents an effort to make NASA's perspective of Earth more accessible to the people who depend on its land.

By connecting satellite-based environmental information with agricultural intelligence and optimization, we hope to help users look beyond individual observations and understand the broader environmental picture.

TerraWise — Read the Land from Orbit.
